steps.what: Check activity bookings, facilities and participant requirements
Choose suitable recreational and entertainment activities and their sequence
Write the programme, timing and operating instructions
Explain the final programme and operating instructions to activity leaders
Supervise the actual activities and respond to changing conditions

tasks.design: Use the native activity-booking view in {OTHER} and reusable programme layouts in {DOCS}. The supervisor chooses the programme, writes its specific timing and instructions separately, briefs leaders and supervises delivery.
tasks.previous_blocker: Booking references and familiar programme sections are repeatedly copied.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing booking views and programme layouts may reduce those particular clerical operations.
tasks.still_hard: Weather, participant ability and facility conditions can change what is safe or enjoyable.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor adapts the programme to real participants and actual conditions.
tasks.altitude: Less programme assembly leaves a little more attention for activity delivery.

evidence.claim: Native booking views and programme templates can reduce navigation and repeated programme layout; the time estimate is model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is activity content, programme writing, leader instructions and programme-level supervision. Staff allocation and daily work coordination are counted in23161 rather than duplicated here.

OTHER means the recreation booking system. Booking staff produce dates, location, group size and stated requirements; the supervisor checks them in s1 and writes activity, timing and operating instructions in s3. Retained12 lookup and16.25 programme-writing hours include checking and capture. Missing requirements are clarified manually.
Test native views and layouts before code. There is no automatic activity selection, safety flag, programme publish or staff notification action.
The programme is an existing working document used by leaders. Its author save has no self-approval gate or saving; no trailing delivery record is added.
unknowns: Current programme format and booking metadata quality
research_questions: Which programme sections are genuinely reusable after participant and facility checks?

steps.what: Check available workers, current duties and operating requirements
Choose workers' assignments and coverage priorities
Write the worker assignments on the existing duty board
Communicate the final assignments and immediate priorities to workers
Direct workers during delivery and coordinate responses to operational changes

tasks.design: Use a native staff-availability view and duty-board form in {HCM}, linked to the {OTHER} activity-booking context. The supervisor chooses assignments, writes them separately and communicates them to workers before coordinating live delivery.
tasks.previous_blocker: Names, availability and repeated duty labels are copied across planning surfaces.
tasks.enabler_now: A native staff view and reusable duty labels can shorten lookup and entry.
tasks.still_hard: Absence, skill gaps and unexpected demand need a supervisor's response.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor knows when a nominally available worker needs help or a different assignment.
tasks.altitude: Less duty-board copying leaves more time for live support without expanding assignment authority.

evidence.claim: Shiftbase supports availability, shift scheduling and swaps, supporting native staff-view capability rather than this local duty-board saving.
The duty-board design and time allowances are model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is worker allocation, actual assignment writing, assignment communication and live coordination. Activity programme authorship is in23168 once; long-term roster preparation is separate.

Workers and scheduling staff produce availability and existing shifts; the supervisor checks worker, duty, time, location and skill relevance in s1-s2 and captures assignments in s3. Retained12 lookup and12 assignment-writing hours include all checking and capture. Missing availability is checked manually.
OTHER means the activity-booking system. Test native staff views and duty fields before code. No automated allocation, staff score or background assignment send is proposed.
Writing a duty assignment and communicating it are separate. The author save has no self-approval gate or saving; oral internal instructions remain fully retained.
unknowns: Current duty-board writing effort and native duty-label support
research_questions: Does native assignment entry remove repeated labels without obscuring skill and location constraints?

steps.what: Write the vacancy and requirements to recruit staff members
Publish the final vacancy to the intended recruitment channel
Review applications against the role requirements
Interview candidates about relevant experience and activity responsibilities
Write the factual candidate evaluation
Choose the hire within existing authority
Write and check the offer with the agreed employment terms
Send the final offer to the chosen candidate
Enter the accepted hire and verified starter details in the employee record

tasks.design: Use existing vacancy, evaluation and offer layouts in {ATS} and {DOCS}, and a native starter form in {HCM}. The supervisor retains candidate assessment and hiring choice; vacancy publication, offer send and accepted-hire entry occur separately at their proper stages.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stable vacancy headings, candidate identifiers and employment terms are copied across forms.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates and applicant views may remove those clerical operations without ranking applicants.
tasks.still_hard: Relevant skills and responsibility for participants require individual assessment.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor probes an unclear answer and judges evidence against the actual work.
tasks.altitude: Less hiring paperwork leaves more attention for fair interviews; hiring authority is unchanged.

reach.role: First-Line Supervisors of Personal Service Workers
reach.learn: Role criteria and accurate employment terms

evidence.claim: Native recruitment forms and document templates can reduce repeated headings and field entry, with no measured local saving or automated candidate judgement.

assumptions: Boundary includes vacancy writing and publication, application review, interviews, evaluation writing, selection, offer writing and send, then accepted-hire entry. Existing recruiting administration retains invitation handling; no invitation automation or saving is claimed.

The supervisor produces role duties and requirements in s1 and checks application facts in s3; applicants supply their facts and interview answers. Retained6.5 vacancy,13.5 review and8 evaluation hours include all capture and checks. Missing facts are explored manually, never inferred scores.

The supervisor writes candidate identity, role, pay, hours and start date from agreed terms in s7, whose six retained hours include checking. The accepted candidate supplies later starter details; s9 retains7.5 hours for capture and verification. Missing or conflicting terms require manual writing.
Test native templates and forms before code. All real publish and send work remains fully retained with exact-final-version gates. Ordinary internal author saves have no gate and no saving.
unknowns: Existing ownership of recruiting administration and starter entry
Availability of reusable role and offer layouts
research_questions: How much clerical work remains after field reuse, candidate evidence checks and final-term verification?

tasks.short: Brief workers about group interests and needs

steps.what: Review the group's stated interests and special needs
Clarify practical requirements with the group contact
Write the necessary practical briefing for the assigned workers
Send the final group briefing to the relevant workers
Inform workers about the needs and check their understanding

tasks.design: Use a native group-booking view in {OTHER} and an existing briefing layout in {DOCS}. The supervisor clarifies the practical needs, writes the actual briefing, separately sends its final version and explains what workers need to do.
tasks.previous_blocker: Booking references and repeated briefing headings are searched and copied for each group.
tasks.enabler_now: Native booking views and briefing sections may remove those operations without inferring sensitive needs.
tasks.still_hard: A brief label may not explain the accommodation the group actually needs.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor asks respectful practical questions and gives workers usable instructions.
tasks.altitude: Less briefing assembly leaves a little more time to clarify accommodations.

reach.learn: Practical accommodation and minimum necessary disclosure

evidence.claim: Native group-booking views and briefing templates can reduce repeated references and layout without replacing clarification or worker communication.

assumptions: Boundary includes source review, group clarification, the actual working brief, its send and worker explanation. It does not create an additional log or include activity programme authorship already counted in23168.

OTHER means the recreation booking system. The group contact supplies stated needs and interests; the supervisor verifies group, date, practical accommodation, affected activity and intended workers in s1-s3. Retained16 retrieval and18.75 writing hours plus20 clarification hours count capture and checking. Missing needs are clarified manually rather than inferred from a diagnosis or group label.
Test native views and layouts before code. No model classifies participants and no automatic briefing send is proposed.
The briefing author's ordinary save has no gate or saving; the separate internal send is gated on the final text and recipient group and retains all10 hours.
unknowns: Current briefing format and real source-review effort
Which practical information the assigned workers need
research_questions: Does the existing briefing layout remove copying while retaining accurate and limited practical instructions?
